source: curated by hand (2026-11-03, mcp-server.md §12.9) from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on windows, 2026-11-03 and the evidence listed
summary: Classic Buzz subtractive polysynth: two PWM oscillators (SuperSaw and more) plus a sub, a 6-pole multimode filter with its own envelope, an amp envelope and two LFOs. For supersaw leads, pads and basses.
use_for: Thick detuned-saw leads, stacks and pads from a polyphonic synth with a multimode filter.
quirks: Plays an octave low: notes_write adds 12 semitones so the written pitch plays (profile).
Several parameters share a name (" - Decay" for the filter and the amp; " - PWM Rate" for both oscillators): use the plain name ("Decay", "Filter envelope decay") or #index.
One voice per track, 12 at most (notes_write spreads chords over tracks).
Velocity is a track column, 0–240 (224 by default); Length (in ticks) ends notes on its own.
Quiet at its defaults: one note measured −26 LUFS.

parameters.name: OSC1 Wave
parameters.description: Waveform: sine, triangle, SuperSaw, PWM square and more, or user waves A–D.
parameters.how: Chooses oscillator 1's waveform: sine, triangle, a stack of detuned saws, pulse and odd shapes, a saw, or one of the user waves.
parameters.sound: Sine is pure, the stacked saws give the big supersaw sound, and the odd shapes give hollow or vocal colours.

parameters.name: - PWM Rate
parameters.how: Sets the speed of oscillator 1's pulse-width movement, 0 to 239.
parameters.sound: Slow movement gives a gentle chorus-like animation; fast movement gives a buzzing shimmer.

parameters.name: - PWM Depth
parameters.how: Sets how far oscillator 1's pulse width moves, 0 to 239.
parameters.sound: More depth makes the tone thicker and more animated; 0 leaves the shape still.

parameters.name: - PW Offset
parameters.how: Sets oscillator 1's centre pulse width, -100 to +100 percent.
parameters.sound: Moving it away from the middle thins the pulse and makes it more nasal.

parameters.name: OSC2 Wave
parameters.how: Chooses oscillator 2's waveform from the same list as oscillator 1.
parameters.sound: Different waves in the two oscillators make a fuller, more complex tone.

parameters.name: - PWM Rate
parameters.how: Sets the speed of oscillator 2's pulse-width movement, 0 to 239.
parameters.sound: Different rates for the two oscillators make the sound drift against itself.

parameters.name: - PWM Depth
parameters.how: Sets how far oscillator 2's pulse width moves, 0 to 239.
parameters.sound: More depth makes the second voice move more; 0 leaves it still.

parameters.name: - PW Offset
parameters.how: Sets oscillator 2's centre pulse width, -100 to +100 percent.
parameters.sound: Moving it away from the middle thins the second voice.

parameters.name: - Transpose
parameters.how: Sets oscillator 2's pitch against oscillator 1, -36 to +36 semitones.
parameters.sound: A fifth or an octave gives power chords and thickness; other values give stacked intervals.

parameters.name: - Detune
parameters.how: Detunes oscillator 2 above oscillator 1, 0 to 100 cents.
parameters.sound: A few cents give a fat, beating sound; large values sound out of tune.

parameters.name: OSC Mix
parameters.description: Share of oscillator 2 in the mix: 0% oscillator 1 only, 100% oscillator 2 only.
parameters.how: Sets the balance between the two oscillators: 0 is oscillator 1 only, 100 percent oscillator 2 only.
parameters.sound: The middle mixes both for the full detuned sound.

parameters.name: SubOsc Wave
parameters.description: Waveform of the sub-oscillator, an octave below.
parameters.how: Chooses the sub-oscillator's waveform, which sounds an octave below the note.
parameters.sound: A sine sub adds clean weight; saws and squares add a harder, buzzier bottom.

parameters.name: SubOsc Vol
parameters.how: Sets the sub-oscillator's level, 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: Raise it for more bass weight; at 0 it is off.

parameters.name: Glide
parameters.description: How smoothly the pitch moves between notes.
parameters.how: Sets how smoothly the pitch moves between notes, 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: Higher values give a slide between notes, like a monosynth's portamento.

parameters.name: Flt Type
parameters.description: 6-pole lowpass variants (36 dB/oct), 4- and 2-pole lowpasses, notches, highpass, bandpass, mixed.
parameters.how: Chooses the filter: six-, four- and two-pole low-passes in several voicings, a notch, a high-pass, a band-pass, mixed vocal filters, or none.
parameters.sound: Low-passes darken the sound at different slopes; the mixed ones give vowel-like tones; none leaves the oscillators bare.

parameters.name: - Cutoff
parameters.how: Sets the filter's cutoff before modulation, 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: Low values are dark and muffled; high values are bright. The envelope and LFOs move it from here.

parameters.name: - Reso
parameters.description: Resonance (its meaning varies with the filter type).
parameters.how: Sets the filter's resonance, 0 to 100 percent; its meaning varies with the filter type.
parameters.sound: More resonance emphasises the cutoff with a ringing peak; very high settings whistle.

parameters.name: - EnvMod
parameters.how: Sets how far the filter envelope moves the cutoff, -200 to +200 percent.
parameters.sound: Positive values open the filter on each note and then close it; negative values do the reverse.

parameters.name: - Attack
parameters.how: Sets the filter envelope's attack, 5 ms to 12 s (exponential).
parameters.sound: Short values open the filter at once; long ones make a slow swell.

parameters.name: - Decay
parameters.how: Sets the filter envelope's decay, 80 ms to 12 s (exponential).
parameters.sound: Short values give a plucky pluck; long ones make the sweep last.

parameters.name: - Sustain
parameters.how: Sets the filter envelope's sustain level, 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: Higher values keep the filter open while a note is held.

parameters.name: - Release
parameters.how: Sets the filter envelope's release, 80 ms to 12 s (exponential).
parameters.sound: Longer values let the filter close slowly after the note ends.

parameters.name: - Mod Shp
parameters.description: Bends the envelope's curve one way or the other.
parameters.how: Bends the filter envelope's curve one way or the other, 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: It changes whether the sweep falls quickly at first or lingers, without changing its length.

parameters.name: - Inertia
parameters.how: Smooths manual cutoff changes, 0 to 240.
parameters.sound: Higher values turn jumps in the cutoff into glides and stop zipper noise.

parameters.name: - KTrack
parameters.description: Cutoff follows the note: 100 ct is an octave per octave, −200 to +200 ct.
parameters.how: Sets how far the cutoff follows the note's pitch, -200 to +200 cents per octave (100 is a full octave per octave).
parameters.sound: At 100 the tone stays equally bright across the keyboard; 0 makes high notes duller.

parameters.name: LFO1 Rate
parameters.description: 0.03–21 Hz exponential up to raw 239; 240–254 lock to the tempo (1 to 128 ticks per cycle, as its text says).
parameters.how: Sets LFO 1's speed: 0.03 to 21 Hz exponential up to 239; 240 to 254 lock it to the tempo at 1 to 128 ticks a cycle.
parameters.sound: Slow rates give a long sweep; locked values keep it in time.

parameters.name: - To Cutoff
parameters.how: Sets how far LFO 1 moves the cutoff, -100 to +100 percent.
parameters.sound: Positive values wobble the brightness; negative ones invert the motion.

parameters.name: - To Env
parameters.how: Sets how far LFO 1 moves the filter envelope's amount, -100 to +100 percent.
parameters.sound: It makes the envelope's depth swell and shrink over time.

parameters.name: - Shape
parameters.description: Sine, saws, square, triangle, steps, sample and hold…
parameters.how: Chooses LFO 1's wave: sine, saws, square, triangle, odd blends, steps and random steps.
parameters.sound: A sine is smooth, a square jumps between two values, the random ones are unpredictable.

parameters.name: LFO2 Rate
parameters.how: Sets LFO 2's speed, on the same scale as LFO 1.
parameters.sound: Slow rates give a long sweep; locked values keep it in time.

parameters.name: - To Cutoff
parameters.how: Sets how far LFO 2 moves the cutoff, -100 to +100 percent.
parameters.sound: Positive values wobble the brightness; negative ones invert the motion.

parameters.name: - To Res
parameters.how: Sets how far LFO 2 moves the filter's resonance, -100 to +100 percent.
parameters.sound: The peak at the cutoff swells and fades with the LFO, giving a more vocal movement.

parameters.name: - Shape
parameters.how: Chooses LFO 2's wave, from the same list as LFO 1.
parameters.sound: A sine is smooth, a square jumps between two values, the random ones are unpredictable.

parameters.name: Amp Attack
parameters.how: Sets the amplitude envelope's attack, 5 ms to 12 s (exponential).
parameters.sound: Short values start the note at once; long ones fade it in.

parameters.name: - Decay
parameters.how: Sets the amplitude envelope's decay, 80 ms to 12 s (exponential).
parameters.sound: It sets how quickly the level falls to the sustain.

parameters.name: - Sustain
parameters.how: Sets the amplitude envelope's sustain level, 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: Higher values hold the note loud; 0 makes a pluck that dies away.

parameters.name: - Release
parameters.how: Sets the amplitude envelope's release, 80 ms to 12 s (exponential).
parameters.sound: Longer values let a note fade out slowly after it ends.

parameters.name: Mode Flags
parameters.description: Sum of: 1 restart LFO 1 per note (L1), 2 restart LFO 2 (L2), 4 filter legato (FE), 8 amp legato (AE), 16 pitch quantize (PQ), 32 mono for MIDI (MM), 64 key-track inertia (IK).
parameters.how: A sum of switches, 0 to 127: 1 restart LFO 1 on each note, 2 restart LFO 2, 4 filter legato, 8 amp legato, 16 pitch quantize, 32 mono for MIDI, 64 inertia for keytrack.
parameters.sound: It does not change the sound by itself; it changes how notes retrigger the LFOs and envelopes, so repeated notes sound alike or flow into each other.

track_parameters.name: Velocity
track_parameters.how: Sets the note's velocity, 0 to 240 (224 by default).

track_parameters.name: Length
track_parameters.description: Ticks until the note ends on its own, 0–15 (240 raw: held).
track_parameters.how: Sets how many ticks the note sounds before it ends on its own, 0 to 15 (the top step holds it).
track_parameters.sound: Short values give staccato notes without writing note-offs.
